objective: Add current-robot-relative orientation feedback throughout the full joint training loop and improve real complete-motion tracking.

evidence.learning_transition: Analytic arm was 0/40 at 2000 iterations and 20/40 at 2793; 3000 is now an interim milestone.

requires_implementation_before_launch: Remove runtime wall_seconds from dataset compatibility semantics; use documented source, ordered motions, frame counts, rate, joint/body order and preprocessing version
Implement goal_frame in physical sampling, imagined steps and terminal critic, PPO, evaluation and any diagnostics actually used
Use current predicted root orientation in imagined goal with state gradients retained
Remove optional hash calculations and restoration drills from the actual training/evaluation/publication invocation paths
Record complete evaluation trajectories for both scoring and video rendering

data_definition.legacy_record_policy: Keep historical metadata unchanged; use explicit recorded semantic provenance if loading old checkpoints.
data_definition.restore_scope: Only the current 40-motion working dataset and any specifically needed weight asset; no full historical archive.

goal.reference_heading_Q: Yaw component of the current reference root quaternion
goal.robot_root_Q: Current physical robot full root quaternion; current predicted full quaternion during imagination
goal.orientation: inverse(Q) * future_reference_quaternion, encoded with existing rotation_6d
goal.velocity: Future reference root linear and angular velocity expressed in Q coordinates
goal.remaining_limitation: Pure robot XY translation remains unobservable to the actor
goal.deployment_assumption: Simulator root orientation is available; corresponding hardware estimation and initialization are future work

paired_training.loop: collect simulator data -> fit differentiable world model -> update actor and critic
paired_training.initialization: Fresh same-seed network initialization for both arms; no trained warm start and no initialization hash check
paired_training.execution: Dedicated tmux, robot_root arm first, then reference_heading; serial by default
paired_training.preserve: Reward, physical termination, PD, noise, randomization, model sizes, optimizer settings and learned termination BCE
paired_training.wall_cap_behavior: Publish actual finals; compare largest common published iteration; do not silently extend

evaluation.termination: Original reference-relative height >0.25m OR gravity-z difference >0.8
evaluation.primary_score: Original full-motion completion and full-duration normalized return
evaluation.repeat_only_if: An observed borderline variation would change the substantive conclusion
extra_metrics: common surviving prefixes with duration/sample count
evaluation.tracking_coverage: alive AND root position error<=0.3m AND root SO3 error<=0.4rad, divided by full reference steps; failed tail zero
evaluation.targeted_diagnostics: Only real failure windows needed to explain a concrete remaining question

publication_cleanup.git: Source, actual configs, plans, compact results and one results/index.json
publication_cleanup.release: All retained checkpoints, original trajectories/arrays, videos and large logs
minimum_upload_confirmation: expected file name and byte count
publication_cleanup.failed_upload_policy: Keep each unpublished file and report it; continue unaffected work.

decision_after_results.improved_orientation_and_return: Continue robot_root; next round matched-input PPO and training seeds
decision_after_results.improved_orientation_but_drifting_XY: Study estimated velocity/relative displacement; mark any simulator position oracle as a separate mechanism upper bound
decision_after_results.persistent_get_up_failure: Inspect actual contact-transition, orientation representation and model prediction in those failed motions
decision_after_results.imagination_reality_gap: Use actual failed windows to motivate a subsequent H=16/H=32 or model-learning change
decision_after_results.no_improvement: Publish actual result and revise based on concrete failure evidence

stop: After the two specified runs, complete evaluation/video, GitHub publication and exact artifact cleanup; report next evidence-based step.
